objective: Audit the boundary between algebraic Lean declarations and claims about analytic PDEs.
context: 129 source-text signatures from six BSA-R rounds; train Steps 2–5, dev Step 6, test Step 7; duplicate lemma names assigned to latest split. Source classification alone does not certify a theorem.

steps.name: Extract signatures
steps.description: Identify named hypotheses and types using pinned source.

steps.name: Classify scope
steps.description: Separate integer algebra, abstract types and analytic statements.

steps.name: Identify missing premises
steps.description: Explain the analytic bridge needed for a PDE implication.

steps.name: Audit independent evidence
steps.description: Require kernel and analytic evidence where appropriate.

specific_questions.prompt: Derive the finite-dimensional vector Lagrange identity and state the additional conditions needed to apply pointwise algebra to a field.
Explain why an abstract type named R is insufficient evidence of a real-valued analytic theorem.
Give an example of a missing-premise claim and a distinct unsupported-PDE-lift claim, with a reproducible review rule.
